text:
Maya: Quick copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages — need final lines for the webinar CTA and the benchmark snippet for launch posts. Sketch below.

Oliver: LGTM, can you drop the two-sentence benchmark blurb we tested? Need it for the social assets.

Maya: Sure — proposed blurb: "Redwood Inference delivers sub-50ms token latency for common open models at 8k context, with up to 2–3x lower per-token cost vs naive GPU endpoints." Thoughts?

Sam: That reads strong. Maybe avoid exact numbers in the top hero — put the numbers in the benchmark panel and use "industry-leading" in the hero.

Taylor: +1 to Sam. Hero should be simpler: "Low-latency, predictable LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." CTA pair: "Try Hosted — free credits" / "Talk to sales" buttons.

Indra: For inbound routing, recommend this split so leads end up in the right queue: demo requests -> Sales (Dedicated/Private), trial API key activations -> Growth Ops. Quick mapping below.

Indra: ```
/signup -> growth (auto-activate trial)
/request-demo -> sales (asg:enterprise)
/webinar-register -> marketing-webinars
```

Maya: Perfect. Lina, can you draft the 1-paragraph benchmark panel and a 3-line webinar promo for the hero and social posts? @Lina

Lina: On it. Drafts by EOD. Webinar promo (first pass): "Join our 45-minute workshop: production runbooks, cost-control patterns, and live Q&A with infra engineers. Perfect for engineers and platform teams." Link: https://redwood.example/webinar

Kyle: On the Dedicated page, call out: "Reserved GPU capacity, configurable autoscaling, and SLA-backed latency targets." Add one short line on burst capacity for cloud peaks. Keep bullets tight.

squad-bot: Reminder: Product review requested in #product at 1769999992

Maya: Thanks — I'll iterate and ping for final review. Also want to A/B test hero copy: "Predictable inference" vs "Production-grade LLM inference". Need quick experiment setup.

Oliver: Use feature flag `hero_copy_v2`, 50/50 split, measure signup rate and demo CTA clicks over 7 days. Add a tracking tag to the webinar CTA.

Maya: Great — I'll push the first revision to the /copy drive and tag everyone. :raised_hands:
